Ops recipes

Server-side operations AUREM can't run on your infra (we don't have SSH to your boxes). Copy-paste runbooks below for the most common issues. ORA links here when you ask things like "restart supervisor" or "free disk space".

Restart supervisor (services aren't running)
When: Backend/frontend showing 502 · supervisor process died · after deploy
sudo systemctl status supervisor
First check if supervisor itself is alive
sudo systemctl restart supervisor
Restart the whole daemon
sudo supervisorctl status
Confirm all services show RUNNING
sudo supervisorc
